subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four exact-pin test repairs and a rebase, do the updated third-party action revisions have approval to run in OpenClaw’s privileged security, credential, release, and agent workflows?
rationale: The mechanical assertion fixes are clear, but approving new third-party code in security-labeled privileged workflows is an ownership decision that automated review cannot safely make.

options.title: Approve after exact-head validation
options.body: Repair the four assertions, rebase, rerun focused guards, and approve the immutable action revisions for these privileged workflows.

options.title: Split or defer sensitive bumps
options.body: Remove any action revision that lacks owner confidence and land only the independently approved updates.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Repair the four assertions, rebase, rerun focused guards, and approve the immutable action revisions for these privileged workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties the exact identity assertions to this owner, and the affected workflows include repository-wide security and automation boundaries.
